bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks, holdalls, rucksacks, and similar bags of any size are not allowed into the arena. A small bag is defined as no larger than A4 (12 x 8 x 3 inches) or a standard handbag.

parking.note: The O2 Belfast provides more than 1,500 spaces across its front, rear, and Riverside car parks, including designated accessible bays. Rates apply and exiting after a busy event can take about an hour.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The O2 Belfast. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: The O2 Belfast offers a luxurious experience with its Shared Suites, featuring a dedicated waiter service and a food and beverage menu. Guests can enjoy exclusive VIP entrance and luxury surroundings, including a private cloakroom and rooftop smoking deck.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: On event nights, a clearly signposted accessible entrance operates to the right of the main doors, with staff available to help.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: The O2 Belfast may offer a smoking pass-out system that lets you exit and re-enter the arena. If one is running, keep your ticket, as it is used for exit and re-entry.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Mobile tickets must be downloaded directly to your phone. Screenshots won't work.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: If you have a floor (standing) ticket for Doors 1 to 2, enter through the internal entrance opposite Hollywood Bowl. Floor ticket holders enter a one-way area with its own restrooms and bars; to leave it, collect a wristband opposite Door 1.
